claims: Named completed-capture tests reject malformed/missing lengths, persistent UTF-8 byte-count mismatches, and malformed/missing child status.
Named tests preserve verified empty output, Unicode byte counts, exact recovery reads, and completed nonzero child status.
Named capture-read tests require successful native read completion and reject failed zero-byte/exact-size output or plausible metadata without replaying the child command.
Completed exec fallback reads validate the native code getter; successful empty native FS reads and explicitly best-effort timeout124 behavior are preserved.
scope: Historical revision-specific local regression evidence, not all-capability or current/future-tree native certification.
limitations: Only named local command regression cases are covered; native behavior and other operation contracts remain unverified.
No clean dependency installation or live provider execution was performed; the existing installed dependency store was reused.
Length equality is not a checksum, arbitrary binary integrity, or remote cancellation/cleanup guarantee.
Timeout exit 124 intentionally returns best-effort partial output; background launch is not completed-capture verification.
Early poll-failure cleanup remains outside these cases; real provider FS/exec behavior remains unverified.
Installed native API declarations/implementations were inspected; mocks do not establish raw HTTP guarantees or compatibility across the entire declared SDK version range.
